sent_subject: Heather & Pine Q4 landing‑page fixes (CEO‑proof teardown)
sent:
Eilidh —

Here’s the short version that moves paid results fastest, with minimal dev. Then a one‑pager you can drop in front of your CEO.

1) Serum offer page (not the PDP)
- Promise match: H1 repeats the ad’s exact promise. Sub: “Fragrance‑free, sensitive‑skin safe.”
- Above the fold: bottle image, 30ml pre‑selected, one Add to cart. Apple Pay/PayPal stay but styled secondary.
- Proof early: “As seen by 2M+ on TikTok” + ingredient line: sea buckthorn, squalane, vitamin E.
- Friction cuts: hide “Estimate shipping,” collapse long sections, add a mobile sticky Add to cart, and swap the Instagram embed for a static tile on paid landers.

2) Variant and dispatch hygiene
- Default to 30ml; move the 15ml (Back in 2 weeks) behind a “Notify me”.
- Surface dispatch next to the CTA: “Poured Mon/Wed/Fri • Royal Mail 48.” Add a seasonal “Order by [date] for Christmas delivery” as cut‑offs approach.

3) Reviews and social proof
- Hide empty Reviews. Replace with one UGC pull‑quote or creator credit if you have it; otherwise keep the TikTok reach badge near the CTA.

4) Mini‑routine gift set (Q4)
- Create a “Cleanse + Glow” set (Oat Bar + Serum) with a single promise and one CTA on its own page.
- Price or bonus it to hit your £40 free‑shipping threshold out of the box.
- Pin ingredients people recognise in scan‑lines: “Sea buckthorn, squalane; oat beta‑glucan.”

5) Measurement in 7 days
- Run serum traffic 50/50 to: a) this offer page, b) the current PDP.
- Watch: click‑to‑ATC rate, checkout starts, first‑order CPA.
- Retire the loser; keep creating variants of the winner weekly.

CEO one‑pager (pasteable)
- One ad, one promise, one page.
- The page keeps the ad’s promise in the first screen and gives one action.
- Early proof beats long copy. Remove anything that makes the buyer think.
- We’ll know it worked in a week from ATC rate and CPA.

If you want, I’ll sketch the serum page wireframe we’d test first.
